resources.string: Device collection is enabled; recorded data is sent to your server
Allow Worker notifications to keep collection visible, then enable telemetry
Collecting locally; app history requires Usage Access
Storage full: collection cannot advance until delivery resumes
Collection paused or failed; check permissions and reopen the Worker

Optional collection of screen/lock state, battery, connection type and power state. With the separate option below: app activity history and app names/versions. Data goes to the server configured for this Worker, using the same encrypted local queue as location. No screenshots, messages, URLs or media content. No AI analysis or automatic alerts. Location has its own independent switch.
Grant Usage Access in Android settings first, or uncheck app usage collection
Enter a whole number from 10 to 900 seconds

Starts from enabling, not earlier history. After an interruption, at most 24 hours of Android history are queried; known gaps are reported. Android/OEM power restrictions can delay collection and delivery. Force-stop requires reopening the app. Disabling stops new collection but already recorded events may still be delivered and remain on the server. Disable before changing options.
